label: PTPRZ1::MET

sections.text: PTPRZ1 encodes a receptor-type tyrosine phosphatase enriched in the nervous system.
MET encodes the hepatocyte-growth-factor receptor tyrosine kinase.

The fusion increases MET expression and enhances MET phosphorylation, promoting oncogenic signaling. It is recurrent in a subset of high-grade gliomas and has shown transforming effects in experimental systems.
An adverse survival association was reported in the original glioma cohorts. Those historical cohorts require reinterpretation under current IDH-based integrated diagnoses.
